main_text.p: Contrà formamus hanc proposi-tionem: Potestas Magistratus se extendit ad omnes partes officii Episcoporum seu ministrorum Ecclesiæ. Hanc totius Ecclesiæ Reformatæ doctrinam esse patebit ex sequentibus, quam D. Amesius paucis his verbis complexus est: Nulla res, persona aut causa tam est Ecclesiastica, quin aliquâ ratione pertineat ad jurisdictionem Magistratus. Medull. Theol. de Magi-stratu p. 325. Quâ in re sequutus est Petrum Martyrem, qui Locis com-mun. Classe IV. cap. 13. §. 9. ait: Rursus Politica potestas ad omnia exten-ditur, quæ ad potestatem Ecclesiasticam (in quibusdam exemplaribus legitur Politicam, sed errore typographico, ut ex toto orationis filo, unusquisq; videt) pertinent. Sed quonam tandem modo? An requirit civilis potestas bonos animi motus & intimam pœniten-tiam. Non potest ipsa hæc effi-cere: opta-bit tamen ut habeantur, & utetur iis

page.notes: Left margin: a small printer's mark (asterisk-like) beside the line "totius Ecclesiæ"; no marginal note text. The first word "Contrà" and the initial "M" of "Magistratus" are decorative swash capitals. Line 1 is a fragment ("ro ex ...") continued from the previous page. "lequentibus" in line 1 is printed with a letter that looks like l; read as sequentibus [?] in the text. "Politicam" in "Politi:am" is hard to read at the line end; read as Politicam [?] in the text. Right-hand head "§. III." is a section mark, not a running head or page number, so it is not transcribed. Digitiser watermark at lower right omitted.
